question: Once a published `imsg` release containing the GUID-linked fix passes exact-head proof, should OpenClaw immediately retire `coalesceSameSenderDms` and make that release a hard iMessage startup floor?
rationale: The change intentionally converts previously accepted config and older binaries into fail-closed upgrade states; tests can establish mechanics, but maintainers must accept the release and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Land after packaged proof
options.body: Publish the fixed `imsg` release, verify the packaged binary with this exact OpenClaw head, then accept the hard floor and doctor migration.

options.title: Preserve the fallback longer
options.body: Keep the existing OpenClaw option and client-side merge path through another release window before requiring the dependency and config upgrade together.

recommendation.title: Land after packaged proof
recommendation.body: Publish the fixed `imsg` release, verify the packaged binary with this exact OpenClaw head, then accept the hard floor and doctor migration.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on publication and support policy for the `imsg` version that becomes OpenClaw’s mandatory floor.
